strings.jp:
そこのむさ苦しいあんた。
道を空けて頂戴
strings.en:
You there, the scruffy one.
Clear the way, would you?

strings.jp:
生意気なアマっこが!
音を上げさせてやるわい!
strings.en:
Cheeky little missy!
I'll make ya cry uncle!

strings.jp: あたしの邪魔をするからよ
strings.en:
That's what you get for
getting in my way.

strings.jp: どう?　少しは懲りたかしら?
strings.en:
Well? Learned your lesson
yet, hmm?

strings.jp: やったわねぇ!　こ、このっ…

ガハハハ!　参ったか!?
この生意気なアマっこめ!
strings.en:
Gwahahaha! Had enough!?
Cheeky little missy!
